metadata.title: Social media audit and 90-day plan
metadata.description: An audit of your social accounts, brand identity and strategy, followed by a concrete 90-day plan for content, publishing and growth.

hero.audit_social_media_cu_plan_de_90_de_zile: Social media audit with a 90-day plan
hero.ne_uitam_la_tot_ce_ai_online_si_iti_dam: We review everything you have online and give you a 90-day plan on a single page. In 10 days.

ce_primesti.profil_feed_continut_ritm_comunitate_cif: Profile, feed, content, rhythm, community, metrics and the path to sales. Everything from the free checklist, done by us.
ce_primesti.pe_o_singura_pagina_ce_schimbi_in_ce_ord: On one page: what to change, in what order and why.
ce_primesti.fara_jargon_fiecare_problema_vine_cu_ce: No jargon. Every problem comes with specific actions to fix it.
ce_primesti.se_scade_din_prima_luna: It is deducted in the first month
ce_primesti.daca_mergem_mai_departe_cu_na_social_med: If we continue with NA Social Media Lunar, the audit is deducted from the first month.

pentru_cine_e.ai_un_cont_si_simti_ca_nu_merge_dar_nu_s: You have an account but feel it isn’t working, and you don’t know why.
pentru_cine_e.vrei_sa_stii_ce_sa_ceri_unei_agentii_ina: You want to know what to ask an agency before you sign.
pentru_cine_e.vrei_sa_lucrezi_cu_noi_dar_intai_vrei_sa: You want to work with us, but first you want to see how we think.

cum_decurge.ne_spui_ce_conturi_avem_de_vazut_si_ce_t: Tell us which accounts we should review and what concerns you.
cum_decurge.radiografia_si_planul_de_90_de_zile_pe_o: The review and 90-day plan, on one page.
cum_decurge.il_aplici_singur_cu_altcineva_sau_cu_noi: You apply it yourself, with someone else or with us.

intrebari.ce_ramane_la_mine_dupa_na_audit_daca_nu: What do I keep after NA Audit if we don’t continue?
intrebari.planul_de_90_de_zile_e_al_tau_il_poti_ap: The 90-day plan is yours. You can apply it yourself or with someone else.
intrebari.care_e_diferenta_fata_de_lista_gratuita: What is the difference from the free checklist?
intrebari.lista_o_completezi_singur_la_na_audit_tr: You complete the checklist yourself. With NA Audit, we go through each point and give you a plan for what to do next.

celelalte_servicii.conturile_tale_de_social_media_luna_de_l: Your social media accounts, month by month: strategy, 10-12 posts, one filming day and a five-minute report.
celelalte_servicii.filmam_editam_facem_continut_adevarat_cl: We film and edit real content: clips and photos designed for mobile and ready to post.
celelalte_servicii.cont_setat_directie_creativa_primele_8_c: Account setup, creative direction, the first 8 clips and a playbook for your team.
celelalte_servicii.emailuri_automate_campanii_si_o_lista_ca: Automated emails, campaigns and a growing list.
celelalte_servicii.pachete_personalizate_cu_artistii_nostri: Custom packages with our artists: painting, clay and whatever else your brand needs.

ne_vedem_la_cafea.vorbim_deschis_despre_ce_ai_nevoie_si_ca: We’ll talk openly about what you need and what it costs. And yes, the coffee is on us.
